## Standalone finding from 08-23 (not in the roll-up) — SKILLS API
`{FOUNDRY_PROJECT_ENDPOINT}/skills`, preview, header **`Foundry-Features: Skills=V1Preview`**,
bearer scoped `https://ai.azure.com/.default`, RBAC **Foundry User**. A skill is a SKILL.md per the
**agentskills.io** spec. Creating a version auto-creates the parent skill; every update makes a NEW
IMMUTABLE `SkillVersion`; parent tracks `default_version` + `latest_version` => promoting a default
is a METADATA-ONLY REPOINT that changes behaviour for every unpinned reference. Attached to a
toolbox, skills surface as **MCP Resources** under SEP-2640, so "any MCP client — GitHub Copilot,
Claude Code, or your own agent harness — can consume skills WITHOUT any Foundry SDK."
NOT reachable over a PRIVATE ENDPOINT. `azd ai skill create --force` DELETES the skill and all its
versions.                                             [reported 2026-08-23, MEDIUM/AISPM]
=> NOTE 2026-08-24: agentskills.io is the Agent Skills spec that is ALSO the `skills/` component of
   **Agent Plugins 1.0** (TSC: AWS, Cursor, Microsoft, OpenAI, Vercel). Microsoft is a TSC member and
   VS Code + GitHub Copilot are named implementing clients. Foundry's Skills API is therefore a
   distribution point INTO the cross-vendor plugin ecosystem. See agent-plugins_spec.txt.

## Carried forward (reported 2026-08-10) — the identity/control-plane layer
Microsoft Agent 365 (GA since 2026-05-01): tenant-wide agent registry that DISCOVERS SHADOW AGENTS,
ten-type risk taxonomy, block/unblock/reassign via **Microsoft Graph API**. Autopilot agents =
licensed Entra user accounts with mailbox, calendar, OneDrive, Teams presence. New Foundry agent
object model (Agent Application + Deployment collapsed into Agent; `agent_card`, `instance_identity`,
`agent_endpoint`); every new agent gets an Entra Agent Identity AT CREATION; legacy agents have a
NULL `instance_identity`. **"Foundry Agent Applications are NOT registered in the Microsoft Entra
agent registry"** — Microsoft's own documented blind spot. RBAC renamed Azure AI * -> Foundry *.

Updated: 2026-08-24 — no change on the roll-up or the blog.
